scientific_integrity: The infinite identity is proved by explicit inequalities and a binary-subsums lemma, with exact rational checks for the finite exceptions; samples corroborate rather than prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Only the reciprocal-square divisor sum restricted to squarefree positive integers is classified. The tail proof uses the classical Nagura prime-in-short-interval theorem. An unindexed equivalent result cannot be excluded; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Four exact closure components for reciprocal divisor sums on squarefree integers
